name: One-arm dumbbell row

phases.name: row
phases.cue: Pull the dumbbell to your hip

phases.name: lower
phases.cue: Lower until your arm is long

phases.name: reset
phases.cue: Flat back, hand and knee on the bench

formTips: Put one knee and the same-side hand on a bench, the other foot on the floor
Keep your back flat and roughly level with the floor
Let the dumbbell hang at arm's length under your shoulder
Drive your elbow back and pull the dumbbell towards your hip
Lower slowly until your arm is long; do all the reps, then switch sides
commonMistakes: Twisting the torso to swing the weight up
Pulling to the chest with the elbow flared out
Shrugging the shoulder up to the ear
